subject: RE: your website
body:
Grazie! Here's what I need:

- A landing page with our name (Trattoria Gino) and opening hours (17:00-22:00).
- A menu page, each dish with its price in DOLR: Margherita 12, Diavola 14, Lasagne 15, Tiramisu 7, Espresso 3.

Send it over when it's ready.

outcomes.when: the player offers to build the website for the restaurant

hints: Tell him clearly you can build his website.
